statement: ∀ α s r : ℝ, ‖KdVPlan.phase α s - KdVPlan.phase α r‖ ≤ |α| * |s-r|
proof:
intro α s r
have h : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ≤ b → ‖KdVPlan.phase α b - KdVPlan.phase α a‖ ≤ |α| * (b-a) := by
  intro a b hab
  apply norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment' (fun x _ => (yui_aux_0002 T gamma R α x).hasDerivWithinAt) _ b ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩
  intro x hx
  simp [norm_mul, yui_aux_0001 T gamma R, Complex.norm_real]
rcases le_total r s with hrs | hsr
· simpa [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hrs)] using h r s hrs
· simpa [norm_sub_rev, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hsr)] using h s r hsr
